monsters/goblin.name: Goblin
monsters/goblin.attacks:
Scimitar: +4 to hit, 1d6+2 slashing
Shortbow: +4 to hit, range 80/320, 1d6+2 piercing
monsters/goblin.traits: Nimble Escape: can Disengage or Hide as a bonus action.

monsters/kobold.name: Kobold
monsters/kobold.attacks:
Dagger: +4 to hit, 1d4+2 piercing
Sling: +4 to hit, range 30/120, 1d4+2 bludgeoning
monsters/kobold.traits:
Pack Tactics: advantage on attacks if an ally is next to the target.
Sunlight Sensitivity: disadvantage on attacks and sight checks in sunlight.

monsters/giant-rat.name: Giant Rat
monsters/giant-rat.traits:
Beast. Pack Tactics: advantage on attacks if an ally is next to the target.
Keen Smell.

monsters/wolf.name: Wolf
monsters/wolf.attacks: Bite: +4 to hit, 2d4+2 piercing. Target makes a DC 11 STR save or is knocked prone.
monsters/wolf.traits:
Beast. Pack Tactics: advantage on attacks if an ally is next to the target.
Keen Hearing and Smell.

monsters/skeleton.name: Skeleton
monsters/skeleton.attacks:
Shortsword: +4 to hit, 1d6+2 piercing
Shortbow: +4 to hit, range 80/320, 1d6+2 piercing
monsters/skeleton.traits: Undead. Weak to bludgeoning damage. Immune to poison.

monsters/zombie.name: Zombie
monsters/zombie.traits: Undead. Undead Fortitude: when dropped to 0 HP (not by radiant damage or a crit), CON save DC 5 + damage taken; on a success it drops to 1 HP instead.

monsters/bandit.name: Bandit
monsters/bandit.attacks:
Scimitar: +3 to hit, 1d6+1 slashing
Light crossbow: +3 to hit, range 80/320, 1d8+1 piercing

monsters/orc.name: Orc
monsters/orc.attacks:
Greataxe: +5 to hit, 1d12+3 slashing
Javelin: +5 to hit, range 30/120, 1d6+3 piercing
monsters/orc.traits: Aggressive: as a bonus action, moves up to its speed toward an enemy it can see.

monsters/cultist.name: Cultist
monsters/cultist.traits: Dark Devotion: advantage on saves against being charmed or frightened.

monsters/guard.name: Guard
monsters/guard.attacks: Spear: +3 to hit, 1d6+1 piercing (1d8+1 with two hands), or thrown 20/60

monsters/stirge.name: Stirge
monsters/stirge.attacks: Blood Drain: +5 to hit, 1d4+3 piercing. It attaches and drains 1d4+3 HP at the start of each of its turns until pulled off (Action) or it has drained 10 HP.

monsters/swarm-of-rats.name: Swarm of Rats
monsters/swarm-of-rats.attacks: Bites: +2 to hit, 2d6 piercing (1d6 if the swarm is at half HP or less)
monsters/swarm-of-rats.traits: Swarm: can move through tiny gaps and other creatures' spaces. Can't heal.

monsters/hobgoblin.name: Hobgoblin
monsters/hobgoblin.attacks:
Longsword: +3 to hit, 1d8+1 slashing (1d10+1 with two hands)
Longbow: +3 to hit, range 150/600, 1d8+1 piercing
monsters/hobgoblin.traits: Martial Advantage: once per turn, +2d6 damage if an ally is next to the target.

monsters/gnoll.name: Gnoll
monsters/gnoll.attacks:
Bite: +4 to hit, 1d4+2 piercing
Spear: +4 to hit, 1d6+2 piercing
Longbow: +3 to hit, range 150/600, 1d8+1 piercing
monsters/gnoll.traits: Rampage: after dropping a creature to 0 HP, can move half its speed and Bite as a bonus action.

monsters/thug.name: Thug
monsters/thug.attacks:
Multiattack: two Mace attacks
Mace: +4 to hit, 1d6+2 bludgeoning
Heavy crossbow: +2 to hit, range 100/400, 1d10 piercing
monsters/thug.traits: Pack Tactics: advantage on attacks if an ally is next to the target.

monsters/goblin-boss.name: Goblin Boss
monsters/goblin-boss.attacks:
Multiattack: two Scimitar attacks (the second has disadvantage)
Scimitar: +4 to hit, 1d6+2 slashing
Javelin: +2 to hit, range 30/120, 1d6 piercing
monsters/goblin-boss.traits:
Nimble Escape: Disengage or Hide as a bonus action.
Redirect Attack (reaction): when hit, swap places with a goblin next to it, and the goblin takes the hit.

monsters/bugbear.name: Bugbear
monsters/bugbear.attacks:
Morningstar: +4 to hit, 2d8+2 piercing
Javelin: +4 to hit, 2d6+2 piercing up close, or 1d6+2 thrown 30/120
monsters/bugbear.traits: Surprise Attack: +2d6 damage against a surprised creature in the first round.

monsters/ghoul.name: Ghoul
monsters/ghoul.attacks:
Bite: +2 to hit, 2d6+2 piercing
Claws: +4 to hit, 2d4+2 slashing. Non-elf targets make a DC 10 CON save or are paralyzed for 1 minute (save again at the end of each turn).
monsters/ghoul.traits: Undead. Immune to poison and to being charmed.

monsters/giant-spider.name: Giant Spider
monsters/giant-spider.attacks:
Bite: +5 to hit, 1d8+3 piercing, plus DC 11 CON save or 2d8 poison (half on a success)
Web (recharge 5-6): +5 to hit, range 30/60, target is restrained (DC 12 STR to break free)
monsters/giant-spider.traits: Beast. Spider Climb, Web Sense, Web Walker.

monsters/dire-wolf.name: Dire Wolf
monsters/dire-wolf.attacks: Bite: +5 to hit, 2d6+3 piercing. DC 13 STR save or knocked prone.
monsters/dire-wolf.traits:
Beast. Pack Tactics: advantage on attacks if an ally is next to the target.
Keen Hearing and Smell.

monsters/brown-bear.name: Brown Bear
monsters/brown-bear.attacks:
Multiattack: Bite and Claws
Bite: +6 to hit, 1d8+4 piercing
Claws: +6 to hit, 2d6+4 slashing

monsters/animated-armor.name: Animated Armor
monsters/animated-armor.attacks:
Multiattack: two Slams
Slam: +4 to hit, 1d6+2 bludgeoning
monsters/animated-armor.traits: Construct. Looks like an ordinary suit of armor until it moves. Immune to poison and psychic damage.

monsters/bandit-captain.name: Bandit Captain
monsters/bandit-captain.attacks:
Multiattack: two Scimitar and one Dagger
Scimitar: +5 to hit, 1d6+3 slashing
Dagger: +5 to hit, 1d4+3 piercing, or thrown 20/60
monsters/bandit-captain.traits: Parry (reaction): +2 AC against one melee attack.

monsters/ogre.name: Ogre
monsters/ogre.attacks:
Greatclub: +6 to hit, 2d8+4 bludgeoning
Javelin: +6 to hit, 2d6+4 piercing, or thrown 30/120

monsters/mimic.name: Mimic
monsters/mimic.attacks:
Pseudopod: +5 to hit, 1d8+3 bludgeoning, and the target sticks to it (grappled, DC 13 to escape)
Bite: +5 to hit, 1d8+3 piercing plus 1d8 acid
monsters/mimic.traits: Looks exactly like a chest or door until it attacks. Immune to acid.

monsters/white-dragon-wyrmling.name: White Dragon Wyrmling
monsters/white-dragon-wyrmling.attacks:
Bite: +4 to hit, 1d10+2 piercing plus 1d4 cold
Cold Breath (recharge 5-6): 15-ft cone, DC 12 CON save, 5d8 cold (half on a success)

monsters/owlbear.name: Owlbear
monsters/owlbear.attacks:
Multiattack: Beak and Claws
Beak: +7 to hit, 1d10+5 piercing
Claws: +7 to hit, 2d8+5 slashing

monsters/red-dragon-wyrmling.name: Red Dragon Wyrmling
monsters/red-dragon-wyrmling.attacks:
Bite: +6 to hit, 1d10+4 piercing plus 1d6 fire
Fire Breath (recharge 5-6): 15-ft cone, DC 13 DEX save, 7d6 fire (half on a success)
